title: finding(tooling): `census:cross-file-line-citations` gives no reading on `main` — its `non-firing` control cites `page.tsx:462`, and `getJsxManifest` has moved to `:460`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a): a report-only instrument that refuses to print a reading on `main`. Reader: triage first (route and grade; a `tooling` candidate), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10456 (PR objectui#10525), which reported the failure at `9eea12a2b`. ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## Reproduction

The dev's reading was `node scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs` at `9eea12a2b`, which exits 1 with `✗ 1 of 11 control(s) failed -- this run is NOT a reading.`

The seat re-read the sites on `origin/main` at `efbf18de5`:
- `scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs` `CONTROLS` declares the `non-firing` control. It is `from` `packages/components/src/__tests__/layout-containers-declare-containment.test.tsx`, `to` `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`, with subject "module-private, hence the four lines here", `want: 'resolves'`, and why "the cited line declares the `getJsxManifest` the citing docblock says it mirrors".
- The test file's docblock (its line 66) cites `renderers/layout/page.tsx:462`.
- `page.tsx` declares `function getJsxManifest()` at line **460**.
- The last commit to touch both files is `5ea623eab` (objectui#10270).

The census's positive control is pinned on a live line address. That address moved, so the control fails, and the census refuses to print a number: the instrument is blind until the control is re-anchored.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The narrow fix: correct the docblock address, or re-point the control at a citation that cannot drift under ordinary edits. ⛔ The census's own control-failure refusal is doing its job; don't weaken it.
- A structural question for triage: every future edit above `getJsxManifest` in `page.tsx` re-breaks this control. objectui AGENTS.md's rule against cross-file line citations is the governing text on whether the docblock should cite by symbol instead. If it does, the control needs another live citation to stand on.

## Dedupe

Must-hit control `cross-file-line-citation-census|census:cross-file` ⇒ 12 hits, none on this control.
